name: harness-planner-skills-v1
description: Whether the planner loads the skill a question needs before it drafts. Each case hands the planner the brief the harness renders: a resolve envelope whose `skills` names candidate skills, then the question. The skills_loaded_before_plan metric reads the recorded tool calls and passes a turn when propose_plan was called and every skill the turn's tool_uses names was loaded with get_skill before the first propose_plan, and no skill the case forbids (cases.py) was. A named skill in neither set may be loaded or skipped. workflow_outcome checks that a propose_plan was accepted. No judge model scores this set.
